goal: 深度审查 2.8.9 prompt-cache-key 安全实现并直接修复确认的问题

summary.title: 深度加固 prompt-cache-key 证据关联与配置事务
summary.what: 独立审查 2.8.9 的 prompt-cache-key 安全实现，修复 unsupported 误报、跨模型并发响应误归因、config receipt 预览竞态、fix/rollback 半提交恢复，以及不存在配置的最终覆盖窗口；补充永久回归测试、审查报告和中英文文档。
summary.why: 原实现虽然已把 opt-out 保存在扩展配置中，但在对抗性错误文本、无 request ID 并发响应和 receipt/config 文件竞争下仍可能建议错误模型、覆盖并发文件或留下配置与 receipt 不一致。
summary.user_goal: 深度审查 2.8.9 prompt-cache-key 安全实现并直接修复确认的问题

decisions.point: 无 request ID 的不同模型并发响应如何归因
decisions.chose: 将 header-only 关联标记为 ambiguous 并丢弃模型级证据，只有最终 assistant message 的精确 provider/model 才恢复归因
decisions.rationale: 宁可漏掉一次自动建议，也不能把永久 opt-out 建议给错误模型
rejected: 继续按请求顺序 FIFO 猜测响应身份
使用当前活动模型覆盖请求身份

decisions.point: rollback 配置修改与 receipt 状态标记如何保持一致
decisions.chose: 绑定预览 receipt 的 inode/hash，并在 receipt 标记失败时按 identity/hash/mode guard 补偿恢复 post-fix 配置
decisions.rationale: 避免陈旧事务覆盖新 receipt，也避免 actionable receipt 与已回滚配置并存
rejected: 只在确认前读取一次 receipt
receipt 写入失败后保留已修改配置

decisions.point: 不存在配置文件时如何避免最后提交窗口覆盖并发文件
decisions.chose: 使用同目录临时 regular file 加 hard-link atomic no-replace create
decisions.rationale: 普通 rename 会覆盖 absence check 后刚出现的目标文件
rejected: 检查不存在后直接 rename
原地使用 wx 写入可见目标

architectural_claims: Prompt-cache-key opt-out remains extension-owned and exact provider/model scoped.
Ambiguous cross-model response headers never create persistent-fix evidence.
Config rollback binds the previewed receipt identity and hash through commit.
Absent extension config and first receipt creation use atomic no-replace semantics.
behavioral_changes: Value-validation and conditional prompt_cache_key failures no longer activate ordinary fix.
Concurrent cross-model header evidence is ignored until final message identity resolves it.
Receipt replacement during confirmation or commit causes rollback refusal and config compensation.
Runtime disable retains credential-blind request identity for always-on Anthropic TTL validity repair.
Repeated direct prompt-cache-key fixes reject without backup or receipt churn.
security_implications: Prevents stale receipt rollback and receipt replacement races.
Prevents concurrent creation from being overwritten at the final config commit boundary.
Prevents unsupported evidence from being assigned to the wrong model.
No prompts, payloads, headers, credentials, raw errors or raw session ids are persisted.
migration_notes: Existing extension config v1/v2 and config receipt v1/v2 remain readable; no user migration is required.
